angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 605,259 km at 144.53 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.9189 +/- 0.0135 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 144.53 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.87 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract): 605,259 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.92 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5132 +/- 129 K from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2040.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.523, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2040 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.3 dex, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2040 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.22185, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2040 (pscomppars): age 8.7 Gyr, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2040 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.86 km/s, from Guenther et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
